title: Single-Cell & Single-Nuclear RNA-Seq Framework
description: Standardized bioinformatic processing workflow for core facility clients of 10x Genomics data, covering the Cell Ranger pipeline, including alignment and quantification, ambient RNA removal, doublet/multiplet detection, quality control, filtering, clustering, and automated cell-type annotation.

title: Bulk RNA-Seq Processing and Quantification Workflow
description: Scalable Snakemake workflow for transcriptomics data transcript- and gene-level profiling, as well as QC statistics at various stages of the workflow.

title: Automated Reporting & Visualization Framework
description: Automated report generation using outputs from the above RNA-Seq workflows to visualize key findings such as clustering patterns, cell-type annotations, and differentially expressed genes. Built with Quarto to deliver presentation-ready visualizations and interactive tables.

title: Microbiome Amplicon Sequence Processing Workflow
description: Scalable microbiome amplicon sequence processing workflow for 16S rRNA and ITS amplicon sequencing data, including quality control, denoising, taxonomic assignment, and phylogeny reconstruction.
